entries.description: A lesbian couple who have lived rurally for 10 years on 5 acres of desert land in California. They grow their own food and keep milk goats, chickens, bees and fruit trees, and they live without TV or media. They welcome visits from lesbians who value rural life and physical work and who are working against their racist, classist, ageist and anti-Semitic conditioning. Girl children are welcome. The land has housing, plumbing, electricity and camping space.
entries.raw_text: ARLENE & ARLINE PO Box 511, Desert Hot Springs, CA 92240 (619)329-8916. We are lovers who have lived rurally for the past 10 years. We grow our own food, have milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees. We live simply and happily, without TV and media, in beautiful desert country with big skies filled with stars. We enjoy visits from lesbians who have an appreciation of rural life and physical work, who are making an effort to eradicate their racist, classist, ageist, anti-Semitic conditioning. We are ethnic women. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, desert land with much vegetation and trees, women working the land.
entries.notes: Type: two-woman rule, "We are lovers" and "2 lesbians", so Private/Individual Land. The mailing address is a PO box, so it is not the land. land_state CA was inferred from the mailing state, since the listing describes desert country and the mailing address is Desert Hot Springs. num_residents 2: "We live simply..." and "2 lesbians". Lesbian women from "visits from lesbians". Girl children from "girl children". Farming/self-sufficiency from "We grow our own food, have milk-goats, chickens, bees, and fruit trees". Women of color not coded: "We are ethnic women" describes the owners rather than inviting women of color. The anti-racism statement ("eradicate their racist, classist, ageist, anti-Semitic conditioning") is noted only.

entries.description: A working ranch in Montague, CA, run by two lesbians. They raise and sell bees and honey, provide pollination services, make beekeeping equipment, breed horses, donkeys and poultry, and sell mail-order t-shirts and women's designs. They welcome correspondence from other ranching women but have no visitor facilities. The land has housing, plumbing, electricity and farmland.
entries.raw_text: BEE SONG HONEY FARMS Rt 1 Box 174, Montague, CA 96064. Raise and sell bees and honey, provide pollination services, make and sell beekeeping equipment. Also breed, raise and train Bashkir Curly horses and standardbred donkeys, plus breed and raise a wide variety of poultry, waterfowl and exotics, including peafowl, rare pheasants and emus. Make and sell mail order t-shirts, caps and rubber stamps relating to bees, donkeys, mules, etc, as well as a line of women's designs. Welcome correspondence from other ranching women; no visitor facilities at present. We have/are: 2 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: The mailing address is a rural route ("Rt 1 Box 174"), so it is copied as the land. Type: two-woman rule, "2 lesbians", so Private/Individual Land. num_residents 2 from "2 lesbians" plus "women living and working on the land". Lesbian women coded because lesbians live there. Only correspondence is welcomed ("no visitor facilities at present"). Farming/self-sufficiency because the place is a working farm/ranch raising bees, horses, donkeys and poultry. Archives/cultural work not coded: the t-shirt and design sales read as a side business.

entries.description: An inactive group on 23 very rural, private acres on the central Oregon coast, with primitive cabins, many camping spaces, woods and farmland. One lesbian lives there. She offers skills to share and work trades for space, welcomes new members or residents and girl and boy children, and hopes to revive the group.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA c/o CK, PO Box 44, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Inactive group with 23 acres plus some primitive cabins. Many skills to share. Very rural, very private, many camping spaces, and trees. Appreciate work trades for space sharing. Come share and experience the mild central Oregon coast climate, help realize your dreams and mine. Call Carol before 5 am or between 5-8:30 pm. Bon Voyage. I welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children under control, dogs under 100% control. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 23 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, lots of camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type: the codebook names Penthesileia Inc as a Retreat/Gathering Space example. This listing offers "Many skills to share" and "work trades for space sharing", so it is coded Retreat/Gathering Space. The alternative was Private/Individual Land, since one woman lives there ("1 lesbian"), though she welcomes "new members/residents" and calls it an "inactive group with hopes to revive". The mailing address is a PO box, so it is not the land. land_state OR from "central Oregon coast". num_residents 1 from "1 lesbian" plus "women living and working on the land". Lesbian women coded because a lesbian lives there. Girl and boy children from "girl & boy children under control". Workshops/education from "Many skills to share".

entries.description: Open women's land of 150 acres in Days Creek, Oregon, held by a land trust and dedicated to giving women access to land, especially women who would otherwise be denied it. It is funded by contributions and has a quarterly newsletter. It is looking for women to live and work on the land and is raising money to pay off the mortgage under threat of foreclosure. It welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, girl children, boy children upon agreement, and dogs.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470 (Located in Days Creek, OR ). OWLT is open Women's Land dedicated to provide women access to land, especially those women who would otherwise be denied. We are funded by contributions from women around the country. We have a newsletter that is sent quarterly, with an active mailing list of 250 women. At present, we are looking for women to live and work on the land. We are currently raising funds to pay the remaining mortgage, as the former owners (mortgage holders) are threatening us with monthly foreclosure. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children upon agreement, nonlesbian women, dogs. We have: 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farmland, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type: Land Trust, because the organization is a women's land trust holding the land ("OWLT is open Women's Land"). The unpaid mortgage does not make it a land fund. The mailing address is a PO box; land_city Days Creek from "Located in Days Creek, OR". num_residents left blank: the listing says "women living on the land" but gives no count. Lesbian women coded for this lesbian directory listing. Non-lesbian women from "nonlesbian women". Girl children from "girl children". Boy children from "boy children upon agreement" (conditional). The newsletter is a passing mention and is not coded as a focus.

entries.description: A community of six lesbians on 50 acres 13 miles west of Roseburg, Oregon. Members live independently and come together for big decisions. They practice goddess identification, bless the land, keep it as wild as possible, and plant trees to make up for logging. They welcome girl children, teens and older lesbians. The land has housing, plumbing, electricity, camping space, woods and farmland.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END 886 Raven Ln, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649 (13 miles west of Roseburg). We relate independently of one another - we come together for processing big decisions. We all love living in the country in the safety of women's land. We are dedicated to mother nature and are into goddess identification. We preserve the land as wild as much as possible. We love trees and plant often to make up for patriarchal cutting. We bless the land and so appreciate her cradling us. Nature is our best reflection. We welcome: girl children, teens and older lesbians. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: The mailing address is a street address, so it is copied as the land. The listing also says "13 miles west of Roseburg", so the land may lie outside the city proper. Type: six lesbians living on the land who "come together for processing big decisions", so Intentional Community/Cooperative. num_residents 6 from "6 lesbians" plus "women living and working on the land". Lesbian women coded for the lesbians living there. Girl children from "girl children". The gender of "teens" is not given, so boy children are not coded. Spirituality/ritual from "into goddess identification" and "We bless the land". Environmentalism/eco-friendly from "We preserve the land as wild as much as possible" and "plant often to make up for patriarchal cutting". Older women not coded: "older lesbians" are welcomed but are not the center of the place.

entries.description: 130 acres of forested land near Roseburg, Oregon, woman-owned for 10 years. Two lesbians live there and earn income from firewood and thinning logging, and they keep dogs, cats and chickens. They possibly welcome new residents, and dogs are welcome. Camping is $3 a day with a one-week limit.

We welcome: new residents (possibly), dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, 2 resident structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space ($3/day, 1 week limit), woods, women living and working on the land.

entries.description: Seven acres in Sunny Valley, Oregon, home to two lesbians aged 57 and 60 with interests in photography, ecology and alternative technology. They welcome women of all ages for short or long visits at $4 a day, and welcome new residents, girl children, boy children for daytime visits only, non-lesbian women and leashed dogs. No guns or drugs are allowed. The land has housing, solar batteries, camping space and woods.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mtn Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. We are 57 & 60 years old with strong interests in photography, ecology and alternative technology. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. We welcome: new residents, girl children, nonaggressive boy children for daytime visits, not overnight, nonlesbian women, dogs (on leash or in car). No guns, drugs, or dope. Smoking limited to outdoor gravel area. We ask $4/day/woman. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 7 acres, housing/permanent structures, solar batteries, camping space, woods, women living on the land.

entries.description: A feminist collective of 5 to 8 lesbians on 23 forested acres in southern Oregon. There is a main house with electricity, hot water and a shower, plus several women-built cabins and secluded camping spots. It welcomes girl children, boy children under age 8 and non-lesbian women for one-to-four day visits when space is available, asking $3 a day for food and $2-10 a day for its land support fund.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE PO Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. WomanShare is a feminist collective of 5-8 lesbians living on forested land in southern Oregon. We have a main house and several women-built cabins and secluded camping spots. The main house has electricity, hot water, and shower. We welcome: girl children, boy children under age 8, nonlesbian women. One-to-four day visits when space is available and we ask $3/day for food and $2-10/day for our land support fund. We have/are: 5-8 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, outdoor toilet, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
